# Publish the Grid-family examples with stable captions

## Context

This is the first examples-consumer leaf of #20498, planned for implementation from Monday, 9 November, after the weekend cut. The [source-backed map](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20498#issuecomment-6697953069) identifies 21 existing Grid-family demonstrations: 14 Grid and 7 Table entrypoints. The steward has put the family-level count, canonical-record direction and this ownership into the parent body.

## The Problem

At Engine `d6358f54e56150fbba68428b4a17dc4c0e062166`, the Portal catalogs list only three of the thirteen `examples/grid` entries. The cards show a name, image, links and platform details, but no feature explanation or concrete action to inspect.

The four curated catalogs also cannot serve as independent caption authorities: numeric id 24 identifies Multi Window Covid in dev mode and TreeGrid Big Data in production. Copying or joining captions by those per-mode numbers risks attaching the right explanation to the wrong application.

Count receipt: the map combines exact-ref entrypoint/config inspection with JSON parsing of the four catalogs, filtered by `sourceUrl`. Big Data, TreeGrid Big Data and Issues are the three positive catalog matches; the id-24 pair is the identity counterexample. These are source counts, not evidence that every example currently runs on the deployed site.

## The Architectural Reality

- `apps/portal/model/Example.mjs` defines the typed record; `store/Examples.mjs` owns the Store; `view/examples/TabContainer.mjs` loads four environment catalogs; `view/examples/List.mjs` renders records and builds navigation.
- `apps/portal/resources/data/examples_{devmode,dist_dev,dist_esm,dist_prod}.json` are curated source data. `buildScripts/create/example.mjs` scaffolds examples; it does not generate these catalogs.
- Catalog order and SharedWorker navigation have delivered intent: #19640 keeps Workstation first and choreography last visible. #19947 retains the Issues showcase and verifies its actual mode URLs. Their narrow exclusions do not require four permanent copies of new metadata.
- Covers resolve through `List#imageBasePath` at Pages' served example-image root; Engine originals alone do not publish an image.
- The Portal is the owner of this consumer change. No engine primitive, example implementation, Brain service or learning-tree move is required.

Design authority: #20498's intended solution requires “twenty-plus captioned demonstrations in the Grid family … every one publicly reachable in the Portal's catalogs,” and selects “catalog identity, exposure and truthful captions … as one consumer change.”

## The Fix

Use one canonical example catalog through the existing Example → Store → List path, with one stable example identity and environment-specific targets on that record. Preserve existing unrelated entries and their established navigation; replace the four independent metadata authorities rather than adding a caption sidecar joined by their current numeric ids. Retain explicit mode-specific external targets, including the DevIndex distinctions recorded by #19433/#19108; do not derive every URL by prefixing its source path.

Expose a clearly reachable Grid-family overview within the Portal's Examples area, retaining the four environment selections. Each entry names the feature and one action/observable result; include a source-bound scale or limitation only when useful. Keep Grid and Table named accurately.

The initial family inventory is the following existing entrypoint set, not new engine features:

```
examples/grid/animatedRowSorting
examples/grid/bigData
examples/grid/cellEditing
examples/grid/container
examples/grid/contentSizedRows
examples/grid/covid
examples/grid/headerGroups
examples/grid/issues
examples/grid/lockedColumns
examples/grid/nestedRecordFields
examples/grid/tree
examples/grid/treeBigData
examples/grid/valueBanding
examples/serverside/gridContainer
examples/table/cellEditing
examples/table/container
examples/table/covid
examples/table/nestedRecordFields
examples/tableFiltering
examples/tableStore
examples/tablePerformance
```

Workstation's Scale and Feed panes may supply labelled contextual links; they do not add entries to that set. Neither do environment variants or the three internal render variants of Table Performance.

## Contract Ledger

| Target surface | Source of authority | Proposed behavior | Fallback / edge case | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Example records and catalogs | Existing Example/Store; parent and exact source map | One canonical identity and caption record per example, with environment targets | No cross-catalog join on legacy numeric ids; no competing metadata authorities | Field JSDoc and this contract | Parsed set/identity checks; deliberate id-24 conflict control |
| Environment and source navigation | TabContainer and List link methods; #19640/#19947 | Correct dev, dist/dev, dist/esm and dist/prod destinations; preserve existing external/source links and SharedWorker behavior | Existing hidden/device rules remain intentional; context panes are not counted as standalone entries | Existing consumer JSDoc | Mode matrix and actual first-card/representative Grid navigation |
| Feature and look-for captions | Source-backed example view/controller/Store behavior | Every family entry renders a truthful feature and one concrete observation | No future capability or unverified scale/compatibility claim | Record text and visible overview | Real Portal card text, not test-injected metadata alone |
| Covers | Existing image lookup and publication convention | Correct example image or an intentional, useful fallback | No broken image request or unrelated screenshot used as proof | PR capture/publication notes if assets change | Card-size visual read; served-byte handoff for any new asset |

Decision Record impact: none. This is Portal catalog/overview work under the accepted parent, with no new domain or runtime boundary.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The canonical family set contains the 21 identities above exactly once, with one authoritative caption record each; all thirteen `examples/grid` entries are discoverable.
- [ ] The Portal offers a visible Grid-family overview. Each entry renders its feature and look-for text from the real catalog through Example/Store/List, with accurate Grid/Table names and source-bound scope.
- [ ] All four environment selections produce the intended targets. Existing external/source links, hidden/device rules and SharedWorker navigation remain correct. Workstation retains its established first-card destination, and choreography remains last visible in the general catalog.
- [ ] Existing unrelated examples are retained. The old four-way metadata duplication is retired as part of the migration; stale numeric-id joins are not used.
- [ ] Each card has an appropriate cover or intentional fallback. Any new cover's Engine original and actual served-publication handoff are identified; a local image file is not called deployed.
- [ ] Focused catalog/model checks and a real Portal consumer test cover set membership, mode targets and rendered captions. A browser receipt follows the first featured card to identifiable Workstation UI and a representative family link to its actual Grid UI, rather than accepting HTTP 200 or a generic mounted app. Relevant required CI passes.
- [ ] The PR supplies a short, factual public-summary paragraph and links its visible result for the publishing seat. It makes no traffic, adoption or performance claim from the inventory.

## Post-Merge Validation

Euclid retains the served-site read after the Engine package/site publication: the public Portal exposes and captions the 21 family demonstrations, with working intended links and any new cover assets at their served locations. Coordinate the release/deploy and outbound click with their existing owners; do not create a second deployment path. Record the public result under #20498. Source-PR merge alone does not discharge the parent's live-publication or outbound condition.

## Out of Scope

New Grid capabilities or examples; row grouping, aggregation, pivot or server-backed paging implementation; unreleased-product claims; API docs; learning-tree/page moves; Workstation behavior changes; broad reordering of unrelated examples; a new deployment/publishing mechanism.

## Avoided Traps

- A hand-written overview or four manually copied captions: both decay independently of the example.
- A caption join on per-mode integer ids: the existing id-24 collision disproves that identity model.
- A generic manifest/discovery framework in this leaf: the named alternative is per-example manifests compiled into the same Store, if local ownership later warrants the extra machinery.
- Counting panes, modes or internal variants to meet the family bar; relabelling header grouping/value banding as row grouping; treating a JSON-loaded view as a server-side row model.
- A source-only or HTTP-only receipt presented as public UI acceptance.
